title: How to compare email marketing platforms for small business: features, pricing, deliverability, and ease of use

findings.text: As an example of how these categories look in practice, Brevo's Starter and Standard plans bundle a drag-and-drop editor with industry-specific templates, unlimited multi-step automation workflows, advanced segmentation by behavior and custom events, an AI content generator for subject lines, and AI send-time optimization that sends each contact's email when they're most likely to engage, according to Brevo's pricing page . Treat this as one illustration of what "automation" or "segmentation" can include when you're reading a features list, not a benchmark every platform must match.
findings.reason: Attributes marketing automation and AI send-time optimization to the Starter plan, but source lists these as Standard-only additions ('Everything in Starter, plus').

findings.text: a user-friendly drag-and-drop editor and visual automation builder are the two features that separate platforms people actually keep using from ones they abandon
findings.reason: Source lists these as top features the reviewer judges platforms on but never claims they determine retention versus abandonment.

assessment: Delivery recovered. Material correction remains: combines Starter and Standard features. Comparative evidence remains uneven; not publication approval.
